rebuild_instructions: 1. Ensure all text files are in the 'data/' folder structured by subject (e.g., math/, physics/, english/).
2. Ensure the topic blueprint CSV exists at 'docs/topic_blueprint.csv'.
4. Run 'python index_builder.py' to rebuild the FAISS index and metadata.
5. The index and metadata will be recreated in the 'index/' folder.
notes: The 'total_chunks' field can be updated after running the preprocessing step to reflect the actual number of chunks created.
